FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Stone Monuments
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Eternal Stone Monuments, we specialize in the design, manufacturing, and retail of personalized monuments and tombstones, serving families and memorial services with dignity and respect. Our operations encompass the sourcing of quality materials, including various types of stone, and the use of modern stone cutting and engraving techniques. We maintain a physical showroom where customers can view our products, as well as an online platform to facilitate order placement. Committed to excellence, we prioritize compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations, ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality and safety. Our team is well-trained in customer service and installation protocols, allowing for a seamless experience from consultation to delivery. We focus on maintaining proper sanitation standards throughout our operations and conduct regular safety audits to enhance our risk management practices. Additionally, we have established contracts with local funeral homes and cemeteries to guarantee clarity in our service obligations, fostering trust within the community.
